name: Are bathroom 3D renderings accurate enough to trust before construction?

mainEntity.name: Are bathroom 3D renderings accurate enough to trust before construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: A 3D design is useful because it can reveal sightlines, cramped circulation, cabinet conflicts, shower proportions, lighting gaps, and finish relationships before work begins. It does not replace a measured plan, construction drawings, field verification, or a review of hidden conditions. Use it to compare options such as one versus two vanities, tub versus shower, or a relocated toilet. Ask what dimensions and assumptions the visualization uses. Elite Remodeling & Design describes 3D visualization as part of its planning options, alongside selections and construction coordination.
acceptedAnswer.description: They are valuable for seeing proportions, sightlines, storage, finishes, and fixture relationships, but they do not replace field measurements or construction review. Ask which dimensions are verified and which are assumptions. Use the rendering to compare layouts, then confirm plumbing, framing, electrical, ventilation, and waterproofing details.
